sam_sales: Quick heads up — NebulaBank just sent an RFP. They want a filled capability matrix + security questionnaire back by Fri EOD and a proposed POC window next month. Key asks: on-prem/HSM support, dedicated latency SLOs, data residency for KMS keys, and committed QPS pricing. I'm attaching the RFP PDF.
anya_se: Got it. SE suggestion: POC = 2-week integration + benchmark. We should include a small integration sprint (3 days) then 10 days of perf tests. Need expected dataset size and target QPS to size Dedicated pool.
lena_security: On the security side — we can cover PCI scope only if they confirm PHI is excluded. If PHI is present we need additional controls. Also need to confirm whether they require vendor-managed HSM or allowing BYO-HSM for Private. Please ask about key residency requirements and any FedRAMP requirement.
karim_finance: Pricing note: they asked for committed monthly QPS + overage. Suggest 3 tier commit options (S/M/L) mapped to reserved GPU counts. I'll draft margin-aware numbers but need expected sustained QPS to compute commit sizes. Also confirm whether they expect included POC credits.
kai_infra: For Private/on-prem: we support customer-managed KMS and BYO-HSM. We'll need their network controls (CIDR ranges), peering requirements, and firewall allowlist. We have a helm chart and a preflight checklist — can share.
sam_sales: Copy. Also NebulaBank asked specifically about model support: text-gen, chat, embeddings, reranking — and whether we support 32k context models and quantized variants. Can we include p99 numbers in the matrix? I want an entry for SLA, SSO/SAML, audit logs, VPC peering, HSM, encryption-at-rest, and FedRAMP (we need to say "not currently" if true).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: file uploaded: https://redwood.internal/files/1750123456/nebulabank_rfp.pdf
sam_sales: Uploading draft capability matrix now: https://redwood.internal/files/1750123456/capability_matrix_draft.xlsx
anya_se: I'll populate performance rows: p50/p95/p99 for typical T=512 and T=8192; include notes on continuous batching, prefix/KV cache behavior, and recommended batch sizes per model. Quick Q: do we want to list quantization options per model variant (int8/int4) or keep it as "quantization supported"? Small table might help.
lena_security: For questionnaire answers: I'll draft terse replies for SOC2, encryption, key management, incident response, and data residency. Note — if they require FedRAMP or IL6, we must flag as blocked until legal/pss review.
karim_finance: Also POC commercial terms: we typically offer 1) free infra credits for benchmarking (one-time), 2) discounted eval rate for 30 days, and 3) refundable credit towards committed spend if they sign within 60 days. I'll include these options in the pricing appendix.
kai_infra: I'll attach the on-prem preflight checklist and helm values snippet by Tue.
sam_sales: Action items: @anya_se fill perf + model rows in matrix; @lena_security draft sec questionnaire answers; @karim_finance produce tiered pricing and POC commercial language; @kai_infra prepare on-prem checklist and required network templs. I'll ask NebulaBank to confirm dataset size and whether PHI is included — if they don't clarify, I'll push the response deadline to Mon.
anya_se: Will do. Expect PR with matrix changes by EOD Wed.
lena_security: On it. I'll also flag any items that require legal (FedRAMP / contract changes) in the questionnaire answers.
karim_finance: I'll post draft pricing options in this thread by Thu morning.
kai_infra: Will post helm snippet + network template by Tue. Also: for Dedicated latency SLOs we can commit to 95% of p99 latency numbers if they take reserved capacity.
sam_sales: Thanks team. Tentative sync Thurs 10:00am PT to finalize artifacts before sending. Anyone can't make it ping here and I'll record notes. :thumbsup:
anya_se: thumbs up
lena_security: 👍
karim_finance: I'll be there
kai_infra: +1"
